key_idea: Look closely at the shape in each tile and which way it points.
steps: The wall has yellow tiles with circles, pink tiles with triangles, blue tiles with diamonds and green tiles with squares.
Every triangle in the wall points up.
Tile D has a triangle pointing down, so it is not in the wall.

choice_feedback.A: Yellow tiles with a blue circle are in the wall.
choice_feedback.B: Pink tiles with a triangle pointing up are in the wall.
choice_feedback.C: Green tiles with a purple square are in the wall.
choice_feedback.E: Blue tiles with an orange diamond are in the wall.
